scope: Replay page preparation, flashback timeline isolation, and unchanged recording contracts
behavior: prepareSeek starts page reads at the user seek event without sampling or acknowledging a displayed frame.
The latest scrub target is serviced when pending reads finish; two pending reads and four cached pages remain the bounds.
Required pages on both sides of an interpolation seam are prepared together.

Read results retain the immutable metadata identity captured when the read began. Flashback replaces or removes future metadata, invalidating late results and failures even when page numbers are reused.
Unchanged earlier pages remain eligible for cache insertion; discarded future reads retain their occupied read slot until completion.
Checksum validation, surface selection, output buffers, and replay presentation remain in the existing sampling path.

local_runs.cases: Initial preparation without presentation side effects; seams; bounded rapid scrubbing; corrupt data; disposal; invalid inputs; late resolution/rejection after flashback; reusing a page id on the new timeline.

failures.test: keeps powertrain energy, damage and fragment poses connected to serialized state
failures.observed: 120 second test timeout during dynamic World import

failures.test: retains the real worker recording cadence during a 24-second consumer stall with surface updates
